answer: Let three randomly assigned independent verifiers approve each new identity before it can trade. Each verifier stakes 200 tokens and earns a 15-token fee only if the identity survives a 30-day horizon with no proven sybil link; a proven fake burns the verifier's full stake and revokes the identity. A haven that rubber-stamps fakes loses stake and licence. An attacker must pay the fee and corrupt three separate verifiers for every fake, so cost grows with each added identity, and a failed batch destroys the corrupt verifiers, while the nectar of free issuance disappears.
